pairs: If you can find a man exercising judgment and seeking faith,
then I will be forgiving to them.
your eyes look with favor upon faith.
and they have refused to accept discipline.
They have hardened their faces more than rock,
and they are not willing to return.
Perhaps these are the poor and the senseless,
who are ignorant of the way of the Lord,
of the judgment of their God.
Therefore, I will go to great men,
et loquar eis: ipsi enim cognoverunt viam Domini,
and I will speak with them. For they have known the way of the Lord,
et ecce magis hi simul confregerunt jugum;
And behold, these ones have broken the yoke all the more;
they have torn apart the bonds.
Idcirco percussit eos leo de silva;
For this reason, a lion from the forest has struck them down,
a wolf toward evening has laid waste to them,
a leopard lies in wait over their cities.
omnis qui egressus fuerit ex eis capietur:
All who go out from there will be taken.
For their transgressions have been multiplied;
Super quo propitius tibi esse potero?
“Over which things am I able to be merciful to you?
et jurant in his qui non sunt dii.
and they swear by those who are not gods.
and they indulged themselves in the house of the harlot.
Equi amatores et emissarii facti sunt:
They have become like wild horses in heat;
unusquisque ad uxorem proximi sui hinniebat.
each one was neighing after his neighbor’s wife.
Shall I not visit against these things,
et in gente tali non ulciscetur anima mea?
And shall my soul not take vengeance on a nation such as this?
But do not be willing to bring about its very end.
for they are not the Lord’s.
Prævaricatione enim prævaricata est in me domus Israël,
and the house of Judah have greatly transgressed against me,
We will not see famine and the sword.’
The prophets have spoken into the wind,
et responsum non fuit in eis:
and there was no answer with them. Therefore,
these things will happen to them.”
Thus says the Lord, the God of hosts:
ecce ego do verba mea in ore tuo in ignem, et populum istum in ligna,
behold, I will make my words in your mouth like fire and this people like wood,
Ecce ego adducam super vos gentem de longinquo,
Behold, O house of Israel, I will lead over you a far away nation,
gentem antiquam, gentem cujus ignorabis linguam,
a nation whose language you will not know,
nor will you understand what they are saying.
Their quiver is like an open sepulcher.
Et comedet segetes tuas et panem tuum;
And they will consume your grain fields and your bread.
devorabit filios tuos et filias tuas;
They will devour your sons and your daughters.
comedet gregem tuum et armenta tua;
They will consume your flocks and your herds.
comedet vineam tuam et ficum tuam:
They will consume your vineyards and your figs.
they will crush your fortified cities,
in which you have placed your trust.
I will not bring the consummation over you.
Quare fecit nobis Dominus Deus noster hæc omnia?
‘Why has the Lord our God done all these things to us?’
et servistis deo alieno in terra vestra,
and have served a strange god in your own land,
sic servietis alienis in terra non vestra.
so will you serve strangers in a land not your own.’
Announce this to the house of Jacob,
and make it known in Judah,
popule stulte, qui non habes cor:
O foolish people who have no heart!
You have eyes, but you do not see,
So then, will you not fear me,
et a facie mea non dolebitis?
And will you not have sorrow before my face?
I have placed the shore as a limit for the sea,
as an everlasting precept that it will not transgress.
et non poterunt; et intumescent fluctus ejus,
but they will not prevail; and its waves will swell,
but they will not go across.
Populo autem huic factum est cor incredulum et exasperans:
But the heart of this people has become incredulous and provocative;
they have turned away and departed.
Et non dixerunt in corde suo:
And they have not said in their heart:
‘Let us dread the Lord our God,
who gives us the timely and the late rains,
who guards the full measure of the yearly harvest for us.’
Your iniquities have turned these things away,
et peccata vestra prohibuerunt bonum a vobis:
and your sins have held back good things from you.
quia inventi sunt in populo meo impii insidiantes quasi aucupes,
For the impious are found among my people;
they lie in ambush like fowlers setting snares,
for they set traps to catch men.
Just as a snare is full of birds,
so are their houses full of deceit.
they have become exalted and enriched.
They have grown stout and fat.
And they have transgressed my words most wickedly.
They have not judged the case of the widow;
they have not given guidance to the case of the orphan;
and they have not judged a judgment for the poor.
Shall I not visit against these things,
aut super gentem hujuscemodi non ulciscetur anima mea?
Or shall my soul not take vengeance on a nation of this kind?
Stupor et mirabilia facta sunt in terra:
Astonishing and wondrous things have been done upon the earth.
and the priests have applauded with their hands,
and my people have loved these things.
Quid igitur fiet in novissimo ejus?
So then, what shall be done at the very end?”
